name: Risograph poster
description: A two-ink risograph poster, 1080 by 1666. Top 38%: a huge three-line headline set tight and flush left in the accent ink, with a small right-hand label column in three groups (what, where, when). Bottom 62%: an image zone in the second ink that bleeds off the bottom and right, with one big accent circle overprinting it. Feels printed, warm and arty.
use: event posters, exhibitions, festivals, markets, workshops, studio nights, zine and magazine covers: anything with a short loud title and a few facts
